headline_hook: Gemini Goes Live, Meta Reads Brains, and Open-Weight Audio Hits Critical Mass
preview_topics: the day open-weight audio went full stack

pick_of_the_day.thesis: TRIBE v2's zero-shot neural predictions aren't just a neuroscience flex — they reveal that foundation model scaling laws apply to biological data the same way they apply to text, and the team that cracks brain-to-model alignment first owns the next input modality after voice.

model_literacy.relevance: TRIBE v2 predicts brain activity for subjects it has never seen. Today's open-weight audio models also generalize to unseen voices and accents. Understanding how models transfer to novel inputs without fine-tuning is the key concept behind all three of today's biggest launches.

items.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Ships With Lower Latency and Smarter Function Calling
items.angle: Google's real-time voice model just got fast enough and reliable enough to make voice-first AI apps viable for production — not just demos.
items.key_fact: Lower latency and improved function calling available now across Google products

items.title: Mistral Drops Voxtral TTS: Open-Weight Text-to-Speech You Can Actually Run
items.angle: Mistral enters the TTS race with downloadable weights — the output end of the speech pipeline just got a serious open alternative.
items.key_fact: 4B parameter open-weight model available on Hugging Face

items.title: Cohere Transcribe Claims SOTA for Open-Source Speech Recognition
items.angle: Between Voxtral TTS and Cohere Transcribe dropping on the same day, both ends of the open-weight speech pipeline just leveled up.

items.title: Google Translate Goes Ambient: Real-Time Translation Through Your Headphones
items.angle: Translation is becoming invisible infrastructure you wear, not an app you open — now on iOS with expanding Android support.
items.key_fact: Live translation via headphones now available on iOS, expanding on Android

items.title: Claude Code Goes Cloud-Native: Auto-Fixes CI Failures While You Sleep
items.angle: Async agent coding just crossed a threshold — your Claude Code session follows PRs and fixes CI without you being at your terminal.
items.key_fact: Web and mobile sessions now auto-follow PRs and fix CI failures

items.title: OpenAI Doubles Codex Rate Limits Across All Tiers This Week
items.angle: If you've been throttled while building, this is your window — 2x limits for the next week across all subscription tiers.
items.key_fact: 2x rate limits for all ChatGPT subscriptions, one week only

items.title: How Cursor Built Fast Regex Search for AI Coding Agents
items.angle: The 'find the right code' bottleneck limits every coding agent — Cursor's engineering team explains how they solved it.
items.key_fact: Directly applicable indexing technique for anyone building code-aware agent tools

items.title: Meta's TRIBE v2 Creates Digital Twins of Your Brain's Response to Sight and Sound
items.angle: Trained on 500+ hours of fMRI data, TRIBE v2 predicts neural activity for people it has never scanned — a foundation model for the brain.
items.key_fact: Zero-shot predictions for new subjects across 700+ participants

items.title: Uni-1: A Single Model That Both Understands and Generates
items.angle: The unification trend accelerates — expect fewer specialized models and more general-purpose architectures that handle both comprehension and creation.
items.key_fact: Built by ~15 researchers, handles understanding and generation in one architecture

items.title: DeepMind Maps How AI Can Be Weaponized for Emotional Manipulation
items.angle: As voice AI gets more persuasive, DeepMind's research on exploitation vectors across finance and health is required reading.
items.key_fact: Proposes new safety measures against AI-driven emotional exploitation

items.title: From Zero to Production RAG: An Honest Post-Mortem of What Actually Breaks
items.angle: The non-obvious failure modes in production RAG systems — the kind of practitioner wisdom that saves you weeks of debugging.
items.key_fact: Documents both successes and failures with specific failure modes identified

items.title: Voice-Controlled App Building With Gemini Flash Live in AI Studio
items.angle: Talk out loud, the model keeps pace — a glimpse at what low-latency voice AI enables for developer brainstorming workflows.
items.key_fact: Real-time voice-to-code demo in Google AI Studio

items.title: Karpathy: AI Writes the Code, But the Infrastructure Maze Remains Unsolved
items.angle: Every vibe-coder hits the same wall — services, payments, auth, databases. Karpathy is waiting for agents that handle the full DevOps stack.
items.key_fact: Reflection on building menugen: code was easy, DevOps was the hard part

items.title: Minute-by-Minute: How One Developer Caught the LiteLLM Supply Chain Attack
items.angle: A real-time incident response timeline that doubles as a practical playbook for when your AI dependency gets compromised.
items.key_fact: Detailed timeline of detecting and responding to a live supply chain attack

items.title: Anthropic Throttles Claude Sessions During Peak Hours to Manage Demand
items.angle: 5-hour session limits now flex during weekday peaks (5-11am PT) for free, Pro, and Max tiers. Weekly limits unchanged — plan your heavy sessions accordingly.
items.key_fact: Peak-hour throttling for 5am-11am PT weekdays, weekly limits unchanged

items.title: Federal Court Grants Anthropic Injunction Against U.S. Department of War
items.angle: A legal precedent for AI companies pushing back on government mandates — the details matter for the entire industry's relationship with defense.
items.key_fact: Preliminary injunction granted in federal court

items.title: AI-Assisted JSONata Rewrite: One Day of Work, $500K/Year Saved
items.angle: A concrete case study of AI-powered technical debt elimination delivering immediate, measurable ROI.
items.key_fact: $500K/year cost eliminated in a single day using AI-assisted rewrite
